title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
goal: Solve Min Cost Climbing Stairs: dp[i] = min(dp[i-1] + cost[i-1], dp[i-2] + cost[i-2]); answer is min(dp[n-1], dp[n]).
strategy: dp[i] = min(dp[i-1] + cost[i-1], dp[i-2] + cost[i-2]); answer is min(dp[n-1], dp[n]).
edgeCases: The top is beyond the final stair, and the climb may start at either of the first two steps.
inputRules: Enter a JSON array with at least two numeric costs.
